title: Untitled Scene

cast.name: Mahir Vey of the Glass Mouth

script.text: Mahir is at the cracked plaza, waiting, in the specific way that looks like not waiting. It is dusk; clear and still.
The letter sits in the inside pocket, folded, unopened, where it has been for weeks.
What Mahir wants is to deliver the the ledger page before the watch changes. It has not been said aloud, not even alone, but it is the shape the day is built around.
Auron is here too, on other business, or on business that is made to look like other business.

script.note: hold — the normal, before it stops being normal

beat_job: establish the protagonist inside their normal, and the lack under it

_spine.want: deliver the the ledger page before the watch changes
_spine.obstacle: Auron wants the same thing and got there first
